narrative: Two foul sheets on the board, the upper one opened and not written on today. A dry pen beside them. No new line in the margin. Lower on the same sheet, the short answer he tried alone on Friday. Nothing is added under it this morning.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the sheet and did not mend it.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on draft in The feast, not touched
